content.short: Exodus is a multi-chain software wallet for managing, staking, swapping, and securing crypto assets.
content.description: Exodus is a multi-chain software wallet that helps users manage, exchange, stake, and secure crypto assets from desktop and mobile interfaces. The wallet supports a broad range of cryptocurrencies and emphasizes ease of use, self-custody, real-time portfolio views, and private local key storage. For Cardano users, Exodus supports ADA management and staking inside a familiar wallet experience. It fits the ecosystem as a mainstream software wallet for users who want simple custody and multi-asset access.
content.meta: Exodus is a multi-chain software wallet for crypto storage, swaps, staking, and Cardano access. Explore Exodus on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
